name: ts-plain-1
prompt:
Implement the service described in SPEC.md (in this directory) in TypeScript on Node.js.

- Write all code in this directory; do not read or write anything outside it
  (except the toolchain, package registries and caches).
- Toolchain: Node.js 26.10 with npm; TypeScript 7 (from npm). Network access for dependencies is available.
- Build in release mode: `npm install && npm run build`. The binary must be `./tracker` (an executable file in this directory that starts the service, e.g. a shell script that
  `exec`s node; it receives SIGTERM directly).
- PostgreSQL is already running in Docker (container `tracker-postgres`, port 55432); do not start, stop or
  reconfigure it. Use only the database `tracker_ts_plain_1` (other runs use other databases at the same time); the test
  runner creates it.
- Done means: `python3 run_tests.py ./tracker --db tracker_ts_plain_1` reports 0 failed.
- When done, reply with a short summary of the design.
